command_lease_scope: Ordinary six-completed-physical-tick lease; no wall-clock expiry. Repeated callback mode preserves historical submission cadence. Once-per-step is a separate diagnostic until equivalence is proven.
continuation_observation_scope: Real callbacks are retained in both observer modes; same-frame attempts are distinct events. No attempt creates a callback or carries its credit across frames.

gpu_history.scope: current GPU against source CPU; prior plane hash retained; transition oracle separately verifies both histories

observation_scope: identical test subclass delegates each Main/worker callback once; production scheduling, native health and physics fences unchanged
observer_scope: Full: bounded existing-seam events. Reduced: detailed Main/worker events and participation sampling disabled; completed-step/body and command oracle remains, so not zero instrumentation.

material.byte_scope: submitted_bytes counts CPU staging uploads; target write bytes are estimates, not measured bandwidth
material.timing_aliases: tile_assembly=atlas_assembly; backend_submit=staging_upload+gpu_blit_submit; do not add aliases twice
material.timing_scope: elapsed wall calls including possible waits/descheduling; not GPU completion

material_steps.accepted_upload_scope: selected transactions whose policy identity survives upload; Main separately counts accepted transactions cancelled by texture recreation

selectors_after.null_meaning: source has no diagnostic selector/status API; inspect hashed original source, not a substituted implementation

rendezvous.render_marker_meaning: Earlier RenderingServer calls returned; not GPU completion, scanout or a draw identity.
